items.claim: Daniel Rodriguez has very good hands for MMA and fights behind a jab.
items.quote: He's got very good hands for MMA. He fights behind a jab.

items.claim: Uros Medic has seven UFC wins and all seven are by knockout, plus one on Contender Series.
items.quote: talking about a guy in Uros Medic who's got seven UFC wins and all seven of those wins are by knockout eight if you include the Contender Series win.

items.claim: Uros Medic is not first-round or bust, having knocked out Matthew Semelsberger in the third and Omar Morales in the second.
items.quote: If he was first round or bust, then why did he knock out Matthew Semlesberger in the third round? If he was first round or bust, why did he knock out Omar Morales in the second round?

items.claim: Daniel Rodriguez is almost 40 years old and hasn't fought in over a year.
items.quote: they're meeting now when D-Rod's almost 40 years old. He hasn't fought in over a year.

items.claim: Uros Medic has been super active and fought three times since Daniel Rodriguez's last fight.
items.quote: Medic since the last time that D-Rod has fought, Medic has fought three times, he's been super active and he's building off those performances.

items.claim: Jan Blahovich is 15 years older than Navajo Sterling.
items.quote: This makes Navajo Sterling 15 years younger than the former champion Yan Blahovich.

items.claim: Navajo Sterling is taller and has a reach advantage over Jan Blahovich.
items.quote: He's also two inches taller at 6'4 and he's got a 1 inch reach advantage at 79 inches of reach.

items.claim: Jan Blahovich is still having competitive fights with top guys like Carlos Olberg.
items.quote: he's still having competitive fights with top guys. The current champ Carlos Olberg
